characters.summary: Rayman is a limbless hero who fights using his detached fists for ranged punches, a helicopter hair maneuver for gliding, and various magical or mystical powers acquired throughout his adventures.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to deep water without special costumes
limitations: Cannot swim naturally in deep water in early appearances
Fists must return before striking again

sources.supports: Basic summary, abilities, and game history of Rayman.

feats.claim: Defeated Mr. Dark and freed the Electoons across the original game world.

campaignTags.claim: Rayman uses his hair like a helicopter rotor to glide across gaps.

unknowns: Exact biological origin of his limbless anatomy remains ambiguous.

characters.summary: Reinhardt Wilhelm is a heavily armored crusader who charges into enemy lines, deploys a massive energy barrier shield, and swings a rocket-powered hammer in melee combat.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to attacks from behind when shield is deployed facing forward
mobility: boosting via rocket thrusters during charge
limitations: Barrier Field has a finite health pool and breaks under heavy fire
Charge leaves him overextended if it misses

sources.supports: Reinhardt's background, Crusader armor, and weapon loadout.

feats.claim: Protected Eichenwalde alongside Balderich against omnic forces.

campaignTags.claim: Uses high-tech rocket hammer and energy barrier technology.

unknowns: Exact durability limits of the Crusader armor against high-yield antimatter weapons.

characters.summary: Ryu is a dedicated martial artist who travels the world perfecting his style, utilizing projectile ki blasts (Hadoken), uppercuts (Shoryuken), and forward kicks (Tatsumaki Senpukyaku).
weaknesses: Vulnerable to psychological manipulation regarding the Satsui no Hado
Human physical limitations against supernatural cosmic threats
limitations: Relies strictly on physical stamina and ki control
Prone to inner conflict over dark ki

sources.supports: Ryu's moveset, history, and status as a martial artist in Street Fighter.

feats.claim: Defeated M. Bison in martial arts combat during the World Warrior tournament.

notableResults.citation: Street Fighter II / Street Fighter V

notableResults.note: Scars Sagat with a Shoryuken at the climax of the first tournament.

campaignTags.claim: Can imbue strikes with Denjin/electric properties in certain iterations.

unknowns: True ceiling of his potential when completely unburdened by doubt.

characters.summary: Evil Ryu is the form Ryu takes when consumed by the Satsui no Hado, sacrificing his honorable discipline for ruthless, murderous intent, teleportation, and amplified destructive ki.
weaknesses: Mentally unstable and prone to self-destruction
Consuming dark energy burns through vitality
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard disciplined martial arts with the murderous intent of the Satsui no Hado, granting darker purple aesthetic, increased damage output, and teleportation at the cost of stability.

sources.supports: Background on Evil Ryu and the Satsui no Hado state.

conditional.ability: Dark ki amplification and instant teleportation
conditional.dependsOn: Yielding entirely to the Satsui no Hado

campaignTags.claim: Demonstrates instantaneous movement similar to Akuma's Ashura Senku.

unknowns: Whether Evil Ryu can permanently subjugate Akuma without losing his own humanity.

characters.summary: Power of Nothingness Ryu (Mu no Ken) is the enlightened state where Ryu masters his inner peace, neutralizing the Satsui no Hado with serene, transcendent spiritual energy.

techniques: Mu no Ken enlightened palm strikes

weaknesses: Requires total mental clarity and emotional detachment
characters.formDifferences: Replaces the dark volatility of Evil Ryu with ultimate spiritual clarity, allowing Ryu to nullify malicious energy and strike with absolute purity.

sources.supports: Ryu's spiritual progression and mastery of Mu no Ken.

conditional.dependsOn: Achieving absolute inner peace (Mu no Ken)

unknowns: Limits of the Mu no Ken against cosmic reality-warping entities.

characters.summary: Samus Aran is a legendary bounty hunter equipped with Chozo power armor, a versatile Arm Cannon firing beams and missiles, and the ability to morph into a compact marble bomb dispenser.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to extreme parasitic energy drains without suit upgrades
Susceptible to psychological trauma regarding Metroid extinction
limitations: Suit energy reserves deplete under sustained enemy fire
Certain environments require specialized beam/suit upgrades

sources.supports: Samus Aran's history, Chozo armor, and weapon abilities.

feats.claim: Eradicated the Metroid population on SR388 and destroyed Mother Brain on Zebes.
feats.citation: Super Metroid / Metroid II: Return of Samus

notableResults.note: Destroyed Mother Brain's final form with hyper beam assistance.

campaignTags.claim: Wears advanced Chozo Power Suit armor.
Utilizes sophisticated alien weaponry and energy beams.
Performs infinite Space Jumps to sustain flight.
Compresses her entire body into a small Morph Ball via Chozo technology.

unknowns: Full extent of her integrated Chozo-Metroid hybrid physiology.

characters.summary: Gravity Suit Samus features an upgraded purple Chozo armor variant that completely negates environmental impediments like water and lava resistance while cutting incoming damage in half.

mechanisms: Complete fluid friction elimination in water

weaknesses: Still susceptible to high-intensity corrosive Phazon or extreme vacuum anomalies without further upgrades
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard Varia/Power Suit colors with purple plating, grants freedom of movement underwater, and halves all incoming damage.

sources.supports: Information regarding Samus suit upgrades including Gravity Suit.

conditional.ability: Zero water resistance and 50% damage reduction

campaignTags.claim: Wears the upgraded purple Gravity Suit armor.
Moves effortlessly through water and liquids without movement penalty.

unknowns: Exact alloy composition of the Gravity Suit.

characters.summary: Metroid Suit Samus is the awakened state where Samus's DNA fully manifests Metroid traits, granting her energy-draining touch and overwhelming biological supremacy over Mawkin Chozo.
weaknesses: Danger of losing control to primal Metroid hunger
characters.formDifferences: Replaces mechanical armor with an organic bluish-grey Metroid exoskeleton that enables life-drain abilities and immense destructive power.

sources.supports: Metroid Dread plot details regarding Samus's Metroid Suit transformation.

conditional.dependsOn: Metroid DNA activation under extreme stress

campaignTags.claim: Organic Metroid armor manifested over her physical form.
Drains life force and energy directly from opponents to heal.

unknowns: Whether she can permanently suppress the Metroid hunger without destabilizing.

characters.summary: Phazon Suit Samus is a corrupted state where Samus's suit absorbs raw radioactive Phazon, granting immunity to blue Phazon hazards and powering up her beam into the Hyper Beam.
weaknesses: Risk of total systemic corruption if Phazon is not discharged in time
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard suit colors with dark, sinister red-and-black Phazon plating that replaces standard weaponry with lethal Phazon energy output.

sources.supports: Details on the Phazon Suit acquisition in Metroid Prime.

conditional.ability: Immunity to blue Phazon environments and access to the lethal Phazon Beam
conditional.dependsOn: Exposure to and integration of raw Phazon material

campaignTags.claim: Wears the black and red Phazon-infused suit.

unknowns: Long-term psychological toll of carrying processed Phazon energy.
